Q9033.reason: VCLT Article 31 requires good-faith interpretation by ordinary meaning in context and in light of object and purpose; object and purpose is not the sole criterion.

Q9036.reason: A keloid is excess collagen forming a firm raised scar mass beyond the original wound, not a flat hairline scar from too little collagen.

Q9037.reason: Tracheostomy is placed below the larynx to secure the airway and commonly aids weaning from prolonged ventilation; it does not restore vocal-cord movement.
